game_concept: A speed quiz set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round, a new hot soup pots challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the cases value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of hot soup pots by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sleigh Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Sleigh Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 46 seconds.
